description: The Pilgrims, a group of English Separatists, endeavored to find religious freedom and escape the dominion of the Church of England by voyaging to the New World on the Mayflower.
example: The Pilgrims were a group of English settlers intent on finding religious freedom and to live apart from the rule of the Church of England, who voyaged to the New World on the Mayflower.
